qa_pairs.question: How have the legal instruments for providing Customs Duty exemptions on industrial parts and machinery evolved from the Customs Act, 1969 to the Customs Act, 2023?
qa_pairs.answer: The legal framework for Customs Duty exemptions on parts and machinery has transitioned from utilizing section 19 of the Customs Act, 1969 [0-7] to utilizing section 25(1) of the Customs Act, 2023 [8-11], often in conjunction with section 126(1) of the Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012, to facilitate local production of specific goods.
